title: SB029 · Antony wakes the crew (source scene 23B)
subtitle: Five shots · reshoot in Aswanth's night look · Ranjith, 2026-11-13

panels.title: He leaves the rail
beats: Start = SB029 last frame. 1.0 s the fire flares; 1.5 s he looks right, toward the bow.
2.5 s he pushes off the rail and runs out of frame RIGHT; hold on the empty rail and the fire.

panels.title: Aerial: he runs in and wakes Babu
beats: 0.3 s he bursts out from the deckhouse corner past the lantern, runs along the right side to Babu.
3.5 s kneels, shakes him; 4.5 s points out to sea; 6 s Babu up on one elbow, looks. Six sleep on.

panels.title: MCU: Antony's line
beats: Kneeling, RIGHT hand on Babu (out of frame left), LEFT arm pointing past the right edge, toward the fire.
2.0-3.6 s: "ബാബുവേട്ടാ, അങ്ങോട്ട് നോക്ക്!" in Malayalam, head steady, slow push-in; then jabs the left arm, looks back out.

panels.title: Babu sees the fire
beats: Antony crouched centre, three-quarters to Babu, LEFT arm pointing RIGHT at the fire (same direction as the close-up).
Babu follows his arm, 3.0 s sees the boat, sits up; focus pulls to the fire at the right fifth. Silent.

panels.title: MCU: Babu wakes the crew
beats: Glances back at the fire (right), turns left to the sleepers.
2.0-3.8 s: "എണീക്കെടാ! വള്ളം കത്തുന്നെടാ!" in Malayalam, then heaves onto his knees.
